methodological_rigor.justification: The pipeline integrates ResNet152-based tissue segmentation, mRMR + LASSO feature selection, comparison of seven ML classifiers, SHAP-based interpretability, VIF check, nomogram, and DCA, with temporal validation (74 training / 30 temporal / 94 TCGA + 64 GSE mechanistic). Several classifiers achieve perfect training AUC=1.000, acknowledged as likely overfit, and the selected LR model has narrow CIs but small validation n=30. Missing-data imputation is mentioned without specifying method. R0-only inclusion induces selection bias explicitly acknowledged. No true external validation cohort for the predictive model; TCGA is used only for mechanism.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Predicting NCIT response in resectable locally advanced ESCC from pretreatment biopsy H&E has clear clinical appeal, and integrated Model A (AUC 0.897 training, 0.809 temporal) outperforms clinical-only and pathomic-only models. However, single-center development with small temporal validation, R0-only selection, and no external prospective validation limit translational readiness. LoE corresponds to low-quality cohort (Oxford 4) for prognostic/predictive research.

reporting_quality.justification: TRIPOD is applicable to this diagnostic/predictive model. Many items are addressed: participants, outcomes, candidate predictors, sample size discussion (implicit), missing data handling, model development, internal (temporal) validation, discrimination (AUC, DCA, confusion matrices), and intended use. Key TRIPOD items are under-reported: full model equation, calibration plots, predictor handling details (imputation specifics), and TRIPOD checklist. Data sources are partially public (TCGA, GSE160269); tool versions are cited but code availability not explicitly stated.

novelty_literature.justification: Combines deep-learning pathomics specifically for NCIT (chemoimmunotherapy) response in ESCC with mechanistic anchoring (CD4+ memory T cells, UPR/ER stress, EIF2S3 hub via TCGA + scRNA-seq). The combination of predictive modelling with molecular-mechanism exploration extends prior ESCC-PS (Li et al.) work and fills a documented gap for NCIT-specific biomarkers.

writing_presentation.justification: Well-structured with clear pipelines, thorough tables/figures, equations for spatial weighting, and detailed mechanistic interpretation. Some passages are dense and a few equations/symbols (OR = 0.2695% CI CI) contain typographical errors. Figures 1–8 and supplementary figures are referenced in a logical narrative.

key_strengths: Integrated Model A (ECiT + T stage + P53) outperforms clinical-only and pathomic-only models in both training and temporal validation
Mechanistic bridge from pathomic features to EIF2S3/UPR axis using TCGA and single-cell data
Rigorous pipeline with mRMR + LASSO, multiple classifier comparison, SHAP, VIF, nomogram, and DCA
Explicit attention to overfitting risk and clinical utility
key_concerns: Single-center training cohort (n=74) and small temporal validation (n=30), with R0-only selection
No true external predictive validation; TCGA used only for mechanism
Incomplete TRIPOD reporting (calibration, full model specification, imputation details)
PD-L1 data not collected, precluding benchmarking against the most widely used biomarker
chief_reviewer.rationale: Technically thorough pathomics+mechanism study that is well-suited to a Tier 3 oncology/translational journal once TRIPOD-aligned reporting, external validation plans, and minor textual corrections are addressed.
